transcript.text: I need to flag something important. I just received the soil test results from the proposed garden area yesterday, and the lead level came back at 180 parts per million. According to the district garden standard, that reading requires us to remove the top six inches of soil and use raised beds instead of in-ground beds. This result came in after the draft plan was circulated, so it's not yet in the project folder. We'll need to revise the plan accordingly before moving forward.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I also need to flag a site issue. My utility-locate request just cleared this morning, and the site is approved for work on October 28 — but not before that date. Facilities policy requires a posted site permit before any excavation or bed assembly. Since the draft plan scheduled the volunteer workday for October 18, we'll need to push that date back to October 28 or later to comply.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report on the purchasing requirements I've verified. A community-garden grant will reimburse up to exactly $4,200 for this project, but there's a key condition: purchases must be covered by a purchase order issued before ordering in order to use the grant funds. The grant office sent me the award confirmation yesterday, and I have not yet attached it to the draft budget. I'll get that done so we can leverage these funds.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to report on a student-safety requirement I've verified. My student health review, which I completed this week after the draft equipment list was prepared, identified a documented severe latex allergy among the students scheduled for garden instruction. Per our school safety protocol, this requires two changes to the plan: first, we must substitute nitrile-only gloves for the standard latex gardening gloves currently listed on the equipment list; and second, we need to post an allergy-safety notice at the garden entrance. These requirements need to be incorporated into the safety plan before approval.
